signing_lag._doc: Converts 'any official announcement' (def 1) into 'signed merger agreement' (def 2). A share of announcements ARE signed deals on day one; the rest (offer letter / bear hug / committee formed / intent) sign after a gamma-distributed lag, or never.
signing_lag._share_why: Grok thread form split: signed agreement ~35%, letter/bear hug ~40%, soft intent ~25%.
signing_lag._never_why: Committee could reject / price dispute / regulatory or litigation (assumption).
signing_lag._lag_why: Precedents: Tesla-SolarCity offer letter Jun 21 2016 -> signed Aug 1 2016 (41 days); Musk/Twitter offer Apr 14 -> signed Apr 25 2022 (11 days). Related-party deals with special committees usually take 1-3 months. Mean 55d, shape 2 => median ~46d, 80% within ~90d.
